shared_elements: monolithic stone block carved in shallow low relief
horizontal registers/bands of repeated motifs stacked vertically
row of arched or crescent-like curved forms near the top
abstracted small figures/motifs distributed across a broad flat face
justification: Both are large upright stone blocks whose broad faces carry shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal bands, with a row of repeated arched/curved elements running across the upper zone in each. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a dark, heavily eroded stone shaped into an anthropomorphic silhouette with a head, shoulders and a prominent central disc, while B is a rectangular pale block covered with crisply incised profile animals and a many-legged creature, with no figural outline or disc.
